objective: Anchor the NACA 4412 credential reference on a lift coefficient independent of the solve being graded, replacing the current self-referential anchor
rationale: The reference is built as section drag plus induced drag evaluated at the solve's own lift, so a solve that over-predicts lift is graded against a wider band. Measured tonight: a 25.0 percent lift over-prediction inflates the induced term by 56.2 percent and lifts the whole band with it. Grading each rung against its own anchor puts the two best-resolved rungs out of band at 94.2 and 94.5 percent layer coverage while the worst-resolved rung at 4.4 percent coverage passes. The grade can be bought by getting lift wrong in the generous direction, so no verdict from this method is currently trustworthy
citations: Abbott and von Doenhoff, Theory of Wing Sections (1959), NACA 4412 section polar
Anderson, Fundamentals of Aerodynamics, span efficiency bracket
cost_basis: estimate, derivation is arithmetic once the anchor source is chosen; no new solves required
expected_knowledge_gain: A credential grade that cannot be moved by the error it is meant to detect, and a reusable pattern for every bottom-up reference in the wall
outcome: Premise confirmed on primary evidence, then closed. Each rung's Cl and Cd were read from its own postProcessing/forceCoeffs1/0/coefficient.dat last row under /home/ubuntu/certonomous-runs/credential-repair-naca4412-*: medium 263,359 cells 94.2% coverage Cl 0.251941 Cd 0.0244788; fine 645,251 94.5% Cl 0.209318 Cd 0.0182536; finer 1,849,113 58.3% Cl 0.250262 Cd 0.0183291; finer_relayered 1,849,113 4.36% Cl 0.261922 Cd 0.0183329; finer_ngrow0 2,091,678 77.0% Cl 0.239606 Cd 0.0183349. Graded each against a band built on its own lift, the errors are +50.41, +34.64, +13.43, +7.94 and +18.77 percent: the four finest rungs agree on drag to 0.45 percent and their grades span 26.70 percentage points, ordered by how wrong their lift is, with the 4.36 percent coverage rung grading best and the only two above 94 percent coverage the only two failing. The anchor is now thin-airfoil theory on the NACA 4412 camber line (zero-lift angle -4.1545 deg by quadrature against the -4.1 deg the texts report) carried to AR 2.9991 by Prandtl lifting-line, with one e used coherently for both the lift slope and the induced drag, which makes the e = 0.70 to 0.85 bracket collapse to 5.78e-05. The ladder's own Cd spread also left the band as the same defect one term over. Reference 0.013570 +/-27.62 percent becomes 0.015696 +/-9.56 percent; re-graded, every rung reads OUT at +55.96, +16.29, +16.78, +16.80 and +16.81 percent and the four finest span 0.52 points instead of 26.70. Verdict NOT VALIDATED before and after, less flattering not more: the graded rung's error fell 34.64 to 16.29 while the band fell 27.62 to 9.56, and three rungs that read IN now read OUT. Tier stays SOLVER-BACKED; wall rebuilt; self_audit's wall check PASSes. Estimated 15 core-min, spent 0: every number came from solves already on disk plus closed-form theory. Also corrected: OTHER_WORK_STATUS.md attributed its 25.0/56.2 percent pair to finer_ngrow0, which is 14.5 percent over the fine rung; the rung that is 25.1 percent over is finer_relayered, the same 4.36 percent coverage rung that paragraph says passes.
